scope: Check concurrent use of independent DXF codec instances writing and reading separate files in both encodings.

behavior: Four workers each own a separate dxfRW writer, dx_iface adapter, input/output model, reader, and unique temporary path.
Workers alternate ASCII and Binary AC1027 DXF output, import their own result concurrently, and compare the complete typed LINE endpoints with worker-specific values.
The control removes all temporary outputs after the threads join. It does not share codec instances or model objects between threads.

limitations: This is a bounded independent-instance/separate-file concurrency control, not a general thread-safety guarantee; shared codec instances, shared adapters, shared destinations and concurrent debug configuration are outside scope.
AddressSanitizer is not a race detector; no ThreadSanitizer run or Linux/Windows execution is claimed.
Concurrent local DXF read/write does not qualify DWG/DXF semantic support or native consumer behavior.
next: Audit source lifetime and platform numeric/string policies; expand concurrency only when a specific shared-state contract requires it.
